top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records - Signed Statement from Parent (26 TAC §744.623(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A signed statement from the parent stating their child's immunization record is on file at the school they attend was not available to review for 4 children's records.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with food allergies did not have a food allergy plan.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene when necessary (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the director did not intervene to stop a parent from talking to another child in care to correct the child's behavior.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime for Infants (26 TAC §746.2423)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was showing noticeable signs being tired and grabbing at the rails of their crib. The caregiver told the child that they know the child is tired but they have at least an hour before they can lay down. The child then began pushing and biting other children due to being tired and requiring rest.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver served a child in care food they had an identified allergy to, resulting in the child having an   allergic reaction.
